rita: heads-up: merged a small PR that changed a few code block fences and it looks like some internal anchors broke for the CLI snippets :thinking:

rita: CI logs show errors like:
```
WARN: broken anchor /cli/usage#install -> expected `install` but page has `install-cli`
ERROR: markdown parse failed for /sdk/go/usage.md: fenced code block info string contains backticks
```

sam: hmm, did the formatter convert triple backticks inside code blocks? iirc we had an example that shows a shell heredoc with ```yaml inside.

noah: i think that was my change to align shells with the new docs linter. i removed a pair of backticks in one example which inadvertently changed the adjacent header slug. my bad.

rita: easy fix: restore the fenced block and add an explicit HTML anchor above the header for the most fragile pages. e.g., `<!-- anchor: install-cli -->` then the header `## Install` so old mkdocs `#install` links will keep working via redirect.

sam: for a systematic approach we should run the link-checker and also a small script to detect code fences that contain backticks in the info string. i can add a grep in the CI action: `grep -n "```.*`" -R docs | sed -n '1,200p'` and fail fast.

noah: i'll revert the accidental change in the affected files and add the HTML anchors where appropriate. also adding a test case to the docs-unit-tests to render the fence case.

docs-bot: preview build: https://deploy-preview-401--docs.redwood-inference.com/ 16: build passed with warnings :white_check_mark:

rita: one more thing: some external links in the SDK snippets included raw angle brackets, e.g., `<YOUR_KEY>` which docusaurus treats as HTML. surround with backticks to avoid rendering issues.

ops: ops note: when you add html anchors or redirect frontmatter, make sure the CDN is warmed after deploy. pinged infra to watch the next rollout.

sam: PR 401 is ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/401 includes the grep-ci check and the snippet fixes.

noah: thanks everyone, will watch for any new CI warnings and follow up if we see tokenization problems in fenced blocks.

rita: merging after one more quick review. tagging @eng-docs. :shipit:
